r. 5th cl. (ञ्) कृञ् (कृणोति कृणुते)
To hurt, to injure, to kill.
(डु, ञ,) डुकृञ् r. 8th cl. (करोति कुरुते)
To do, to make, to perform any kind of action:
this root admits most of the prepositions and a variety of significations; it is also active or deponent, according to its prefix and import; as,
.²1 With अति,
(अतिकुरुते)
To exceed, to do more.
.²2 With अधि,
(अधिकुरुते)
a To surpass or overcome. .²b To superintend, to govern. .²c To hold of right. .²d To bear patiently. .²e To refrain from.
.²3 With अनु
(अनुकरोति)
To copy, to imitate, to act like or after.
.²4 With अप
(अपकुरुते)
a To wrong, to injure. .²b To do evil.
.²5 With आङ्
(आकुरुते)
a To call. .²b To take shape or form.
.²6 With उत्
(उत्कुरुते)
a To kill or hurt dangerously. .²b To collect, to assemble.
.²7 With उद् and आङ्
(उदाकुरुते)
To reproach.
.²8 With उप
(उपकुरुते)
To befriend, to serve or assist.
.²9 With उप, and स inserted
(उपस्कुरुते, or उपस्करोति)
To alter.
(उपस्करोति)
a To polish, to adorn. .²b To assemble. .²c To reply.
.²10 With तिरस्
(तिरस्करोति)
To abuse, to revile.
.²11 With दुर्
(दुष्करोति)
To do evil.
.²12 With निर् and आङ्
(निराकुरुते)
a To make light of, to contemn. .²b To expel. .²c To annihilate.
.²13 With परि, and स inserted
(परिष्करोति)
To polish, to refine, to make elegant or perfect.
.²14 With पर and आङ्
(पराकरोति)
To act well.
.²15 With प्र
(प्रकुरुते)
a To begin. .²b To do any thing quickly. .²c To serve. .²d To allot, to portion. .²e To violate. .²f To chaunt, to recite.
.²16 With प्रति
(प्रतिकुरुते)
a To counteract. .²b To retaliate. .²c To remedy.
.²17 With प्रति and उप
(प्रत्युपकुरुते)
To requite, to return a kindness;
.²18with वि
(विकुरुते)
a To utter, to sound. .²b To seek, to strive for.
(विकरोति)
a To alter, to change in form. .²b To disturb or agitate.
.²19 With वि and आङ्
(व्याकुरुते)
a To explain, to expound. .²b To make manifest or public.
.²20 With सम
(संस्करोति)
a To polish, to perfect. .²b To assemble, to bring together.
.²21 With सु
(सुकरोति)
To do well.

r. 6th cl. (किरति)
To throw, to scatter.
r. 9th cl. (कृणति) or (गि, ञ्) गिकॄञ् (कृणाति-कृणीते)
To hurt, to injure.
r. 10th cl. (कारयते)
To know.
.²1 With अप prefixed
a To draw furrows, to make lines. .²b To disperse.
.²2 With अव,
To throw, to cast.
.²3 With आङ्,
To fill up, to cover over.
.²4 With प्रति,
To hurt, to injure.
.²5 With वि,
To throw, to caste, to send, to scatter widely.
.²6 With सम,
To gather, to collect.
.²7 With अभि, in the passive voice,
to be upset, overcome or overwhelmed.
